#### Hate

**Rage — Offense only; mandatory; Start Turn.**

- At start of own turn use power; first choose and discard a card from hand.
- Every other player must choose either discard same card type (attack, negotiate, artifact, etc.) or lose three ships of YOUR choice to warp.
- If discarded card attack, opponents must discard attack of equal or higher value. Opponent with no cards of discarded type must lose ships instead.
- If after using power you have no encounter cards in hand, draw new hand.

**FAQ p15:** A required new starting hand is drawn before Hate. You may discard Morph: others need Morph or must lose ships, not substitute the card Morph might copy. Against an attack, a lower attack cannot be discarded; if a player declines or lacks a qualifying card, they discard nothing and lose three ships. A Zap after you select a discard makes you keep it. The printed sheet allows equal-or-higher attacks; the FAQ example uses the word higher rather than equal-or-higher. No supplied erratum expressly changes the printed equality threshold.
